statement: An OpenAI-compatible HTTP/client shape is a real ecosystem convention and can point the same client style at non-OpenAI servers through base_url, api_key and model.
actakit_implication: ActaKit can support an OpenAI-compatible provider adapter as an escape hatch across local/self-hosted/cloud endpoints.

statement: OpenAI-compatible does not mean full API or capability equivalence; supported endpoints/parameters/modalities vary by server and model.
actakit_implication: Provider startup must capability-probe/declare required features instead of assuming compatibility from URL shape.

statement: An OpenAI-shaped API key is not itself a complete security boundary for compatible servers.
actakit_implication: Remote/self-hosted endpoints need explicit trust/TLS/network policy; credentials must remain external secrets.

statement: The compatibility surface can bridge local multimodal servers and cloud-style clients while retaining backend/model differences.
actakit_implication: Transport/provider interface and model capability must be separate concepts in WORKBENCH design.
